basics.name: Jack Stehn
basics.label: Machine Learning Engineer | Data Engineer | Data Scientist
basics.summary: High-agency Data Professional blending rigorous social science research with production-grade engineering. I architect end-to-end data systems, from raw ingestion to deployed predictive models, and bring a software engineering mindset to data teams.

work.name: Innovare
highlights: **K-12 Student Data Quality:** Worked across school partners' student data, including assessment scores, grades, and attendance. Validated it end to end, from source systems to final reports, and wrote automated data tests to catch errors before they reached educators.
**Enterprise Customer Delivery:** Managed data pipelines and delivered presentation-ready insights for enterprise accounts, turning raw data into decisions for non-technical staff.
**Data Architecture:** Helped design a Medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture on BigQuery and proposed an open-source stack (Terraform, dlt, dbt, Dagster, Cube.js) to replace ad-hoc workflows.
**Workflow Automation:** Automated manual customer delivery workflows, reducing turnaround time and freeing engineering capacity for analytics work.

work.name: Caliber Public Schools
work.position: Data Scientist (Lead: ML, Data Engineering, MLOps) - Ed Pioneers Fellow
highlights: **Strategic Leadership (Solo Data Lead):** Owned the full data lifecycle (DS, DE, ML) as sole data scientist, partnering with the C-suite.
**Predictive ML & Risk Modeling:** Deployed explainable staff-turnover models with a 'Risk Tolerance' setting for leadership to tune.
**Modern Data Stack Architecture:** Architected a scalable platform on GCP. Orchestrated ELT pipelines using Dagster, dbt, and dlt to ingest data from disparate SIS and HR platforms.
**Engineering Maturity (ROI):** Engineered a comprehensive People Team data pipeline, reducing manual consistency checks from months of collective annual work to seconds.
**Survey Design & Enrichment:** Enriched staff surveys with demographic, location, role, grade, and tenure data for segmented insights.
**Data Democratization:** Updated the data security policy and built data literacy trainings so school leaders could self-serve metrics.

work.name: SetSail
highlights: **Business Impact:** Contributed to product enhancements that achieved 33% faster ramp times, 16% higher revenue, and 15x ROI for customers.
**Production ML (Revenue):** Deployed Propensity Scoring and Churn models, using NLP on unstructured email metadata to identify sales signals.
**Pipeline Architecture (AWS):** Led a critical overhaul of the AWS data infrastructure. Implemented 'SQL Push-down' strategies and asynchronous DAGs, reducing data processing latency by 75%.
**Causal Analysis:** Ran causal inference studies isolating the sales behaviors that drive outcomes, steering the product roadmap.
**Engineering Best Practices:** Championed the adoption of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), unit testing (pytest), and Agile methodologies.

work.name: UC Berkeley School of Public Health
highlights: **Leadership:** Led data science components for mixed-methods studies on equity and public health. Managed a team of undergraduates.
**Unstructured Data:** Analyzed diverse unstructured and non-traditional datasets requiring the development of novel data processing approaches.
**Geospatial Analysis:** Performed geospatial analysis (ArcGIS) to identify and visualize spatial patterns for non-technical stakeholders.

education.area: Data Science (Domain Emphasis: Quantitative Social Science)
education.summary: Highest Distinction (Summa cum laude). Outstanding Data Science Undergraduate Award (Top of Class).

awards.title: 2020-2021 Outstanding Data Science Undergraduate Award
awards.summary: Recognized for excellence in Data Science undergraduate studies, research, and community contributions at UC Berkeley.

volunteer.summary: Selected for national fellowship applying leadership/management skills to advance educational equity.
highlights: **Leadership Development:** Applying data science & leadership skills to advance educational equity.
**Capacity Building:** Building organizational capacity through strategic data projects at placement site.

volunteer.summary: Provide data-driven insights for policy-making and organizational growth through survey creation and analysis.
highlights: **Team Leadership:** Led volunteer team providing data analysis for organizational strategy.
**Survey Analysis:** Designed & analyzed surveys (qual/quant) informing policy & growth.

references.name: Oscar Vidal (Worked with Jack on the same team at Innovare) - Lead SDET | QA Automation Architect
references.reference:
I enjoyed working with Jack at Innovare. They had a good eye for the data behind our dashboards and were quick to speak up when something didn't look right. While exploring the platform, they raised issues and provided the context and evidence needed to understand them, which helped improve the overall user experience.

Jack was always willing to learn, ask questions, and share what they knew. They picked things up quickly, were patient when helping, and were always willing to help when something needed attention.

I recommend Jack to any team looking for someone who cares about the quality of their work and keeps learning.

references.name: Brian Jimenez (Managed Jack directly at Caliber Public Schools) - Managing Director of People
references.reference: Chosen from over 50 applicants and 5 finalists, Jack joined our organization at a pivotal moment and has been an invaluable team member ever since. Jack streamlined a survey and analysis process that previously took our team a month, developing a replicable system that now delivers actionable insights in just a few days. Jack is an easy choice for any team seeking a results-driven, collaborative data scientist who elevates both projects and people.

references.name: Darrin Gilkerson (Worked with Jack on different teams at SetSail) - Software Engineer at QVT Financial
references.reference: Not only is Jack an extremely capable engineer and data scientist, they are also a collaborative team player who elevates everyone around them. Their contributions at SetSail were always valuable to the company—whether it was their huge role in our data pipeline migration, or countless bug fixes and feature implementations. I wholeheartedly recommend Jack for any data science position.

references.name: Danny Pan (Managed Jack directly at SetSail) - Data Science
references.reference: Jack worked on a variety of projects that involved teasing out actionable insights from complex data sets, enhancing modeling capabilities through feature development and algorithm development, and building out a data ETL process that transformed the data infrastructure to help SetSail scale for enterprise customer needs. I highly recommend Jack as a Data Scientist and Data Engineer for any organization.

references.name: G. Allen Ratliff (Managed Jack directly at UC Berkeley SPH) - Assistant Professor of Social Work
references.reference: Jack is a motivated self-starter who loves to accomplish project tasks while developing and implementing smooth processes in their work environments. Jack is an accomplished leader, utilizing problem-solving skills to support their own work and the work of their colleagues and peers. Jack is a leader who uses imagination, experience, and empathy to create sustainable processes.
